en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I might fall asleep...
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

Hmm... Well, I don't feel like napping.
Not in the slightest bit.
You're still a li'l kid, Shuichi.
Huh!? Dominoes!? With movie boxes!?

Do you think a supreme leader of evil
would do something so childish!?
Who do ya think I am!?

Well...it might be fun if we try
it out!

People always say try new things in life, so
how about we go for the Guiness world record!?
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Wow, Shuichi.
I was just thinking the same exact thing.

Reality is more important than movies.
That's so true.

I can't believe we thought about something
so useless at the same exact time...
Maybe you and I were lovers in a past life!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kokichi's inner thoughts...?
